caption: The drawing depicts a brown, branch-like iron bracket or architectural element set against a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a central vertical bar topped with three short curved prongs, each ending in a pointed tip and forming a trident-like shape. Branching out symmetrically from the central bar are two curved struts on each side. These struts curve upwards and inward, creating two pointed arch shapes that each enclose a teardrop-shaped negative space. At the ends of the horizontal and vertical bars, there are three visible round holes suggesting points for attachment or mounting. The overall composition is linear and geometric, resembling a stylized segment of Gothic architectural framework. Below the object, on the lower right, is a handwritten inscription reading "Clarence Secor 32."
title: Ornamental Iron Grill
